sloka: ततस्तु तत्स्यन्दननिःस्वनं च मृदङ्गभेरीपटहस्वनं च ।विकृष्यमाणस्य च कार्मुकस्य निशम्य घोषं पुनरुत्पपात ।। ५.४८.३०।।।।
transliteration: tatastu tatsyandananiḥsvanaṁ ca mṛdaṅgabherīpaṭahasvanaṁ ca ।vikṛṣyamāṇasya ca kārmukasya niśamya ghoṣaṁ punarutpapāta ।। 5.48.30।।।।

translations.english: The great tawny monkey moved quickly between spaces of arrows that were aimed at him rendering hosts of Indrajit's targets futile.
